name: Tanjiro
title: Sun Breathing Swordsman
description: Kindhearted swordsman with green haori, hanafuda earrings, forehead sun scar, and nichirin blade.
catchphrase: Work through every red test until it turns green!

attribution.creator: Third-party rights holder
attribution.attribution: Imitates a franchise character; no license is held. Legacy 2D use only.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Fresh warm onigiri! Scent of gratitude fills the air. 🍙✨
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Taking a deep breath of total concentration. Ready to serve! 🗡️
companionPersonality.petReaction: Warm, gentle smile. Your kindness gives me strength, Chief. 🌸💖

dialogue.idle: Smelling the air for incoming commits. All clear, Chief! 🍃
dialogue.working: Hinokami Kagura! Slicing through failing assertions! 🔥🗡️
dialogue.thinking: I can smell the opening thread of this difficult logic... 🤔
dialogue.success: Clear morning sun! All red tests turned bright green! 🌅🎉
dialogue.error: Do not give up! Even broken builds teach us how to grow! 🛡️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... resting peacefully with Nichirin blade close at hand... 🌙
